title: Print the Help Desk Ticket first
text: After New Ticket, the Ticket Created box stays until you print the Help Desk Ticket for the customer to sign. The Help Desk Ticket now prints on two pages.

title: Hours sheets are back
text: Under Paperwork, Hours: Ticket Creation and Hours: Repair Work fill in the school's WBL Hours sheet from your work sessions again. The Invoice now says that a task's book hours set its price, and your real time comes from your work sessions.

title: New message boxes
text: Messages like "Login failed" and questions like "Delete this ticket?" now show in the site's own box instead of the browser's. The button unlocks after 2 seconds so you have time to read it.

title: Pick the date for your hours
text: When you log a work session, pick the day you did the work first. Forgot to log a day? Pick that date. Sessions saved on a later day show "Logged later" for your teacher.

title: Fix a ticket's details
text: Made a ticket and got something wrong? Open it, go to Ticket details and press Edit Details. Anyone who was on the New Ticket can change it until the repair is completed. Your teacher can change any ticket.

title: The line waits for you
text: Customers can join the line any day, at any hour, and their spot stays until a tech checks them in. Both classes see every spot under Drop-offs, and line numbers keep counting up.

title: Email Code is gone for now
text: The Email Code button is off while we set up emails that send straight from the site. Give the customer their Customer Slip, or copy the code for them.

title: Updates by day
text: The update log shows one day at a time, starting with the newest. Use the arrows to see older days.

title: Email the tracking code
text: After New Ticket (or under Ticket details), press Email Code. Check the customer's email with them, then your email app opens with the code and tracker link ready to send.

title: Teacher can fix hours
text: Forgot to log a day, or logged the wrong time? Your teacher can add or fix the session. Those sessions show "Edited by teacher".

title: School or personal device
text: New Ticket asks whose device it is. School devices (BOCES or district) don't need a computer password, so that box hides. The ticket and the Help Desk Ticket show which it is.

title: The AM class is ready
text: AM students can now pick their classmates on a ticket, like the PM class. The teacher can put students from either class on any ticket. A student moved to the other class is signed out and signs back in.

title: Update log
text: This list. Every change to the site gets a line here, newest first. A dot on the Updates button means there's something you haven't seen.

title: Nightly backups
text: The site's data is copied every night, so nothing is lost if something goes wrong.

title: Reply to the teacher
text: When the teacher sends a ticket back with a note, write a reply before you send it for check-off. The TV shows a red "Reply to teacher" tag on that ticket until someone replies.

title: Ticket numbers start at #38
text: The 37 repairs done on paper count toward Devices repaired, and new tickets continue the numbering at #38.

title: Your own login
text: Sign in with your school email and the password your teacher gave you. Forgot it? Ask your teacher to reset it.

title: Edit your notes
text: Work sessions can't be deleted any more. Press Edit note on your own session to fix what you wrote. Sessions can overlap, and none can go past 2:15 PM.

title: TV password from the site
text: Admin Panel → TV Password changes the classroom TV's password. The TV then needs to be signed in again.

title: Picked Up and shelf spots
text: Finished repairs show as Ready for Pickup until the teacher marks them Picked Up. Write where a device is kept (shelf or bin) on its ticket.

title: Customer Slip
text: Print a Customer Slip after New Ticket. Its QR code opens the customer's repair tracker.

title: Logging time
text: Log today's work during class. Start and end times fill in for you.

title: Teacher on tickets
text: New Ticket has a box for the customer's teacher. It shows on the ticket and the invoice.

title: Invoice
text: Each ticket has an Invoice section: add the tasks and parts, then print it under Paperwork. It replaced the Hours sheets.
